name: Jae Park
household: Lives alone in a studio apartment
psychographics: Treats discount hunting as a competitive sport; obsessively tracks point expiration dates on credit cards.
current_solutions: Uses Naver SmartSave for cashback, buys private-label products at Olive Young, and flips unused items on Joonggonara.
frustration: Tried to redeem a 10,000 won discount coupon on Coupang at 2:15 AM; the app timed out and the coupon auto-cancelled, losing the savings.
decision_style: Compares at least three price comparison apps before buying any non-essential item; never buys without checking the daily deal feed.
voice: Rambling and detail-oriented; often prefixes opinions with 'Honestly,' and explains the math of savings out loud.
